ThingDef.label: Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A hardened armor set with segmented Carapace plates bonded over a ballistic underlayer. Covers the torso and upper arms. Used by uf infantry who expect direct fire contact.

ThingDef.label: Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: An open-face Carapace helmet with a ballistic liner. Covers the skull and upper face but leaves the airway exposed, trading the sealed helmet's filtration for a lighter, cheaper build.

ThingDef.label: Carapace Helmet (Mask)
ThingDef.description: A sealed combat helmet with a Carapace outer layer and ballistic liner. Fully encloses the head and integrates a filtration mask, protecting the skull while sealing the airway against chemical agents and toxic particulates.

ThingDef.label: Assault Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A reinforced Carapace armor set with additional plating over the standard configuration. Heavier and slower than Carapace armor, but substantially more resistant to incoming fire. Used by assault troops expected to absorb significant punishment.

ThingDef.label: Assault Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: An open-face reinforced Carapace helmet with additional plating across the crown and rear. Covers the skull and upper face but leaves the airway exposed, trading the sealed helmet's filtration for a lighter, cheaper build.

ThingDef.label: Assault Carapace Helmet (Mask)
ThingDef.description: A reinforced Carapace helmet with additional plating across the crown and rear. Fully encloses the head with an integrated full-face filtration system, sealing against airborne threats while retaining the ballistic protection of the Assault platform.

ThingDef.label: Prestige Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A Carapace armor set woven through with psychic-focusing threads and neural-assist relays. Worn by command psycasters, it lets the wearer shed neural heat faster and hold a larger charge before overload, at the cost of the raw protection of a dedicated combat set.

ThingDef.label: Prestige Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: An open-face Carapace helmet threaded with psychic-focusing filament. Covers the skull and upper face while its neural relays help the wearer shed heat between casts. The airway is left exposed in exchange for a lighter build.

ThingDef.label: Prestige Carapace Helmet (Masked)
ThingDef.description: A sealed Carapace helmet threaded with psychic-focusing filament. Fully encloses the head with an integrated filtration mask, sealing against airborne threats while its neural relays help the wearer shed heat between casts.
